usageNotes: Use this to inspect the exact privilege set granted by a specific role before assigning it to a user or token — useful for auditing custom roles or verifying built-in roles like PVEVMUser or PVEAdmin. The roleid must match an existing role exactly (case-sensitive); built-in roles use the PVE prefix convention (e.g., PVEAdmin, PVEVMUser). All authenticated users including API tokens can call this endpoint regardless of privilege level.

examples.summary: Inspect the built-in PVEVMUser role to see which VM privileges it grants

tips: Only privileges set to true are returned in the response; unset privileges are omitted entirely rather than returned as false.
Built-in roles (prefixed with PVE) cannot be modified; use list_access_roles (GET /access/roles) to enumerate all available roles before fetching a specific one.
API tokens with restricted privileges can still call this endpoint — permissions are 'user: all', meaning any authenticated session qualifies.
